subject: Civil Works Project Officer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Justin,

I'm applying for the Civil Works Project Officer role in your Development and Civil Engineering team, which I found on the Yarra City Council careers site. Your name is on the advert, so I wanted to reach you directly as well.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections and quality checks, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day and writing progress reports. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

Your advert describes scoping and inspecting reinstatement works on Council roads and footpaths and guiding contractors to Council standards, which suits how I like to work. I'm based in Melton VIC with a licence and my own transport, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked for a council yet, so I would bring site discipline and learn your Road Management Plan quickly.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

subject: Civil Designer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Proterra team,

I'm applying for the Civil Designer role in Toowoomba that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and from 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, including subdivision finishing works.

Your advert talks about practical, buildable designs for roads, subdivisions and drainage in regional Queensland, and seeing projects through to construction, which is the kind of design work I want. I'm based in Melton VIC, available for regional work and open to discussing relocation to Toowoomba. I hold a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't used 12d Model yet, so I would learn it alongside your engineers.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
